author: The Current
description:
Duluth singer/songwriter Sophie Hiroko stopped by The Current's Morning Show and shared the inspiration behind her song "Divorce." 

Sophie Hiroko will be performing at 7th St Entry Friday, August 7 featuring Lana Leone, Scrunchies, and Ava Levy. 

Find out more about upcoming shows at thecurrent.org/giglist
